newsitem.title: USA: Ocean Financial plans stock buyback.
newsitem.headline: Ocean Financial plans stock buyback.

text.p: Ocean Financial Corp, the holding company for Ocean Federal Savings Bank, said Friday it would buy back up to 430,308 shares, or five percent of its outstanding common stock over the next six months. The Company had applied to the Office of Thrift Supervision, the Company's regulator, for approval to repurchase 10 percent of its outstanding common stock.

The company said the repurchase effort announced today follows one announced in April of this year when the Company disclosed its intent to repurchase 452,956 shares, or five percent, of Ocean Financial Corp.'s common stock. That effort has resulted in the repurchase of all of those shares.
